name: Microsoft SharePoint
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Sites.Read.All, and Sites.ReadWrite.All to add and edit list items; the token address holds your directory ID.

pick.name: search_sites
pick.says: Finds SharePoint sites by keywords in search; without search, lists every site. A site’s id is the site_id the other tools take.

pick.name: get_site
pick.says: Returns one site, by the id search_sites gives, or the root site when site_id is root.

pick.name: list_subsites
pick.says: Lists the subsites of a site.

pick.name: list_lists
pick.says: Lists a site’s lists; system lists stay hidden unless select includes system.

pick.name: get_list
pick.says: Returns a list’s metadata, by its id or its title; expand=columns adds its columns.

pick.name: list_columns
pick.says: Lists a list’s columns; a column’s name, not its displayName, is its key in an item’s fields.

pick.name: list_list_items
pick.says: Lists a list’s items; expand=fields adds their column values, fields(select=Title,Status) only some. filter takes fields/Status eq 'Open' (eq, ne, lt, gt, le, ge, startswith) on indexed columns only: Graph refuses any other column unless sent a Prefer: HonorNonIndexedQueriesWarningMayFailRandomly header, which this tool cannot send.

pick.name: get_list_item
pick.says: Returns one list item; expand=fields adds its column values.

pick.name: list_libraries
pick.says: Lists a site’s document libraries; a library’s id is the drive_id the file tools take.

pick.name: list_library_files
pick.says: Lists the files and folders at the top of a document library; a folder’s id is the driveItem_id list_folder_files takes.

pick.name: list_folder_files
pick.says: Lists the files and folders in a folder of a document library.

pick.name: search_content
pick.says: Searches SharePoint for files, list items, sites, lists or libraries (entityTypes driveItem, listItem, site, list, drive); queryString takes KQL (budget filetype:xlsx) and region, your data location code (NAM, EUR, …), is required. Body: {"requests": [{"entityTypes": ["driveItem"], "query": {"queryString"}, "region": "NAM", "from": 0, "size": 25}]}.

pick.name: create_list_item
pick.says: Adds an item to a list. Body: {"fields": {"Title", …}}, each key a column’s name from list_columns.

pick.name: update_list_item
pick.says: Changes the given column values of a list item and leaves the rest alone. Body: {"<column name>": value, …}.
